title: Ride inside the Glessner brougham, and home to the coach house
items: Ask Charles Nelson for a ride at the waiting Glessner carriage on Prairie: the door opens and you sit inside beside Mr. Glessner.
He drives a round of the block, down Prairie, along 20th, up Indiana and back along 18th, giving way to the other carriages at the corners.
Stop or Get out at any time, by key or touch; you can still climb up beside him and take the reins.
Home to the coach house: he drives in off 18th Street through its doors, which open first and shut behind, and brings it round again when asked.
